title: Meet the 16 Mizaj types (one line each)
caption:
Sixteen types. One of them is you, and you'll know it instantly.

The 16 Mizaj types come in four families: the Thinkers, the Heart-led, the Guardians and the Makers. Each has its own name and its own very specific way of surviving a family dinner.

Save this, swipe till you find yourself, then tag the friend who is obviously The Host.

Which slide called you out?
